Signature: shouldRetry(attempt: number, maxAttempts: number, status: number): boolean.
Inherited domain: All numeric inputs are finite safe integers. Attempts and maximum-attempt counts are positive. Times and delays are nonnegative. Validate all inputs before returning any result; never perform network I/O, wait, read a clock or mutate state.
